title: Minimal selfhood may reduce to transparent self-location

statements.text: In bodiless dreams and asomatic out-of-body experiences the sense of selfhood stays stable while body representation is minimal. The self-identification condition of minimal phenomenal selfhood may then reduce to self-location, giving the more parsimonious definition, after Jennifer Windt, of transparent self-location in a spatiotemporal frame of reference.

sources.quote: the self-identification condition would then be reduced to the self-location condition
pure spatiotemporal self-location suffices for a robust sense of self
